title: Generate a clean 8-panel storyboard image first (two rows of four, each panel…
content:
Generate a clean 8-panel storyboard image first (two rows of four, each panel vertical 9:16 labeled SHOT 1–8 with wide white gutters), then use it as the reference to keep the same character and shot plan consistent across the video.

In Seedance 2.0, instruct: Use the attached image ONLY as a storyboard reference for shot order, character appearance, outfit, and framing; do NOT reproduce the grid layout, panel borders, gutters, or SHOT labels in the video.

Specify the exact deliverable in the prompt: ONE single continuous vertical 9:16 video, 15 seconds long, cutting through 8 shots with explicit timecodes for each shot.

Lock character consistency by stating the subject is identical in every shot (same face, hair, outfit, hat, bag) and tie it to the storyboard reference.

Control lighting continuity by explicitly assigning lighting conditions per shot (e.g., shots 1–6 bright summer daylight; shots 7–8 warm golden-hour light).

To get travel-vlog realism, include style constraints like smartphone travel-vlog realism, subtle handheld camera feel, natural motion blur, true-to-life colors, unretouched skin texture, and add negatives like no text/captions/watermarks.

[3.8-5.6s] SHOT 3 — Cut to a wide landscape shot. Endless rows of purple lavender over the rolling hill, she stands small on the center path, slowly opening her arms, clouds drifting gently.

[5.6-7.5s] SHOT 4 — Cut to a medium shot. She strolls toward the camera with a relaxed natural walk, smiling at the lens, her right hand gently brushing the lavender flowers beside the path, flowers swaying at her touch.

[11.3-13.1s] SHOT 7 — Cut to golden hour. She stands on the hilltop half-turned away, then looks back over her shoulder at the camera with a soft smile, hair and dress moving in the warm breeze, low sun flaring gently behind her.

[13.1-15.0s] SHOT 8 — Cut to a medium close-up in evening light. She smiles warmly and reaches her hand toward the camera in a beckoning "come here" gesture, palm slightly toward the lens, lavender hill glowing behind her, ending on her inviting smile.

The same woman with the same face, hair, dress, hat, and bag in all 8 shots.
